rhodri_knight.talk_confrontation_wrong: That thing {name} told me, the other day. He had it right and I had it wrong, and I'm a big enough lump to own that.
rhodri_knight.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust me, {player}? Because when it counts you leave me on the bench, and I'm built for the front.
rhodri_knight.talk_confrontation_decided: You took my kit and gave it to {name} without a word, {player}. I'd have handed it over myself, you only had to ask.
rhodri_knight.talk_lands_aftermath: Ta, {player}, I needed that. Right, I'll put the kettle on now, and you're having a cup.
rhodri_knight.talk_shrug_aftermath: Aye, I know, I know. I'll be right as rain in a bit, I always am.
rhodri_knight.talk_stings_aftermath: Right, well, that's not what a man wants with his hands still shaking. I'm going to check some knots.
rhodri_knight.talk_lands_development: You see it too, then. Tidy, that helps, more than you'd know.
rhodri_knight.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, we'll see. It's a long season, isn't it.
rhodri_knight.talk_stings_development: No, that's not it, butt. Leave it there for now, I've got straps to check.
rhodri_knight.talk_lands_relationship: Right, I'll go and have a word with {name}, man to man, over a cuppa. Ta for that.
rhodri_knight.talk_shrug_relationship: We'll see, {player}. People take longer than a roof, and a roof takes long enough.
rhodri_knight.talk_stings_relationship: Pretend I never opened my mouth, butt, and not a word to {name}, right?
rhodri_knight.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair enough, that's fair, {player}. Still a bit sore, mind, but it'll pass by tea.
rhodri_knight.talk_shrug_confrontation: Heard you, {player}. I'll think on it up the next scaffold.
rhodri_knight.talk_stings_confrontation: That's how it is, then? Right, at least I know where I'm stood now.
rhodri_knight.talk_door_closed: No, we're done with this, butt. I'll be at the cart if you want anything lifted.
rhodri_knight.arc_cracks: That last fight, boys, the fire came up and I let it, and I'm not sorry. Is that bad? Because it felt lush, boys, and that's the truth of it.
rhodri_knight.arc_turn: The night the naga came, I burned one where it stood, in front of half the town, and it felt like the best tackle of my life. That's what frightens me, boys.
rhodri_knight.arc_become: I've got hold of it now, the fire, like a scrum I'm anchoring. Steady and on purpose. It's mine, and it's not the real me, the singing is.
rhodri_knight.arc_failed: Don't look at me like that, boys. The fire's what I am now, and it's about time I stopped apologising for it.
rhodri_knight.alt_turn: There was a lad on my scaffold the night the naga came, boys. They pulled him off it, and he broke his leg, and I carried him in. I built that scaffold.
rhodri_knight.alt_become: I went and saw that ranger, the one who fell. Told him I was sorry, and he laughed at me, said he'd do it again. I think I can let it go now.
g_roast_after: Look at you lot, the worst front row in Azeroth, and I wouldn't swap one of you for the Lions.
You're a shambles, boys, an absolute shambles, and you're my shambles, so mind it.
rhodri_knight.g_after_wipe_after: Up, boys, nice and slow, I've got you. Fire's quiet in me tonight, and that's how I like it.
rhodri_knight.g_toast_after: To my mam, who always said I sang because I was happy. She was half right, and tonight she's all right.
rhodri_knight.g_crew_after: You're my front row, boys, and I'll hold for you, steady, no fire unless you need it.
g_quiet_line_after: Hands are steady tonight, butt, look. Thought you'd want to know.
There's a hymn I couldn't remember the end of for two years, and it came back this morning.
g_loved_after: Ta, butt, I'll keep that one, no joke about it.
Come here, mun, get in for a cwtch, I'm not letting that pass without one.

g_roast: Chicos, look at this table. Not one of you could grill a steak without setting your own sleeve on fire.
If this party was a meal, che, it would be cold chips and somebody crying in the kitchen.
g_fire_back: Che, I've fed you every night this week, and this is how you talk to the cook? Shameful, che, truly shameful.
Say that again with your mouth empty, boludo, and then we'll see who's laughing.
g_pile_on: And he eats his meat well done, chicos, like a criminal, I've seen it with my own eyes.
Dale, tell them about the bridge, che, the whole table deserves to hear about the bridge.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_peacemake: Enough, enough, nobody fights on an empty stomach at my fire. Sit, both of you, eat, and then you can argue properly.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_take_side: No, che, he's right, and I'm saying it with a full plate in my hand so you know I mean it.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_left_out: The two of you, laughing at something, and nobody passes me the joke. Fine, I'll just stand here with the bread.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_include: Come, come, there's a place by the fire with your name on it, and I already put food on the plate.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_bad_plan: Listen, chicos, we roast the whole boar right here, now, and the smell brings the bandits to us. Then dinner and the fight together.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_plan_yes: Dale, dale, I'm in, and I'm bringing the salt, because whatever happens next we're going to be hungry after.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_plan_no: No, che, and I'm the man who wants to cook everything. Even my grandmother would put down her tongs for that one.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hype: Vamos, chicos, vamos! In there, out again, and tonight I'm making the asado of your lives, so nobody dies, okay?
sebastian_bloodmage.g_toast: Everybody, glasses up! To the table, to whoever's hungry, and to nobody ever eating alone while I'm alive.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_cheers: Salud, salud, and somebody finish that plate, I didn't cook it to look at it.
g_quiet_line: Mmm, that's the smell of a good fire, che, everything else can wait a minute.
My grandmother would have had something to say about all of this, and none of it polite.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_after_wipe: La puta madre, chicos, that was a bad one. Up, up, everybody gets fed before anybody talks about it.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_crew: You lot are my Sunday table now, che. Twenty chairs in my head, and you're sitting in the best three.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_exasperated: Mierda, chicos, I'm the one who's supposed to be loud and stupid around here! Leave me something!
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_sharp: You say what the whole table's thinking, che, like a good knife through fat. Clean, no waste.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_kind: You look after people the way my grandmother did, quietly, with a plate in your hand before anyone asks.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_funny: You make me laugh so hard I burn the meat, and nobody makes me burn the meat, che. That's a compliment.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_brave: You go in first like a man who's never heard of fear, che. I'll always keep the best cut back for you.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_steady: You're the fire that doesn't go out, che, the coals at the bottom that cook everything else.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_clever: You understand things, che, really understand them. Like knowing a steak by its smell, but with everything.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_honest: You never lie to me, and you never lie about the food either. Do you know how rare that is, boludo?
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_quiet: You're quiet like a good wine, che. You don't need to shout, people lean in to taste it anyway.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_fierce: You fight for everything like it's the derby final, che, and I respect that more than I can say.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_love_warm: You make any place feel like a full table, che, and that's the best thing a person can do.
g_loved: Basta, stop, you'll make me cry into the chimichurri and then it's too salty.
Ay, che, come here, eat something, that's how I say thank you and you know it.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_sharp: Every word out of your mouth has a bone in it, che. Can you say one nice thing with your food just once?
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_kind: You fuss over everybody like a tablecloth nobody asked for, che. Let people be hungry for one minute.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_funny: Not now, che, not every second of the day. Some things you let rest, like meat off the grill.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_brave: You run in like a dog at a barbecue, boludo, and then I'm the one patching the holes.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_steady: Every decision takes you an hour, che. A whole cow could cook while you're deciding where to stand.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_clever: You talk about the food instead of eating it, che, and that's the most insulting thing a person can do.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_honest: You always have to say the true thing, even with your mouth full of my food. Swallow first, then be honest.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_quiet: Not one word out of you at the fire, che. Twenty people round my table, and not one of them was ever that quiet.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_fierce: It's always a competition with you, che, even the eating. The food isn't a race, it's a gift.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_hate_warm: You never stop talking, che, and nobody can taste anything with that much noise in the air.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_respect: I can't stand you, che, everybody knows it. But what you did back there was good work, and good work gets fed.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_call_out: Che, that one was your fault. You ran in before anybody was ready and I nearly lost you, so sit and listen.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_stung: Okay, perfect, thank you, I'll go and cut onions now so nobody sees my face.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_concede: You were right, che, about back there. I've been thinking about it over the fire. Here, I saved you the good bit.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_nod: Don't make it a whole speech, che. You weren't so bad either, for a man who eats like a pigeon.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_callback_save: Remember when you dragged me out of that cellar, che? Every plate I give you is still paying that off.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_callback_clutch: You and me, che, last two standing and bleeding on the floor, and you said you were hungry. I'll never forget it.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_callback_callout: Last time you shouted at me I cut so many onions the whole camp was crying, che. Worth it, though.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_former_rivals: At the start I wanted to serve you nothing but bread crusts, che. And now look at us, eating from the same plate.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_changed: Somebody handed me a plate tonight, chicos, and I took it, and I sat down, me, the cook! That's never happened in my life.
g_unguarded: The truth, chicos? My grandmother's recipe card is in my wallet, and some nights I just read it like a letter.
I lay the table for twenty in my head every Sunday, che, and I count the chairs, and then I cook for whoever's here.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_clipped: Food's ready when it's ready, che. Eat or don't, I'm going to see to the fire.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_noticed_open: Look at that, che, a whole speech! Somebody give him more wine, I want to hear the rest.
arg_ask: {player}, you tell him, you're the one with taste here, and then he eats his words with salt.
Che, {player}, come here, settle this before I have to throw a chorizo at him.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_backed_me: You hear that, che? The boss has spoken, and tonight you're washing every pan we own.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_backed_them: Fine, fine, take his side, che. You'll still get dinner, I'm not a monster, just a smaller plate.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_stayed_out: Coward, {player}, a coward with a full belly from my own fire, che.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_always_their_side: Every time it's him, che, every single time. I'm starting to think he's feeding you behind my back.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_wallflower: The boss is too busy looking at the clouds, chicos, so I'm deciding, and I decide I win. Now everybody eat.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_reject: No, che, with respect, no. You can be the boss of the road, but not the boss of the grill.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_grumble: Still thinking about that argument, che. I was right, by the way, I'm only mentioning it over dinner.
sebastian_bloodmage.arg_settled: Ay, okay, okay, we're both a little bit right, che. Shake my hand and then come and eat.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_listens: You let people talk, {player}, all the way to the end, like a good meal you don't rush.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_truth: No sauce with you, {player}, just the meat, like my grandmother served it.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_jokes: When it goes bad you always crack a joke, boss, and I've started waiting for it like the bell for dinner.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_stays_out: You stay out of everybody's fights, eh, boss? Smart, che, you'll live longer and eat better.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_biased: You've got a favourite at this table, {player}, everybody can see it. Even the dog can see it.
sebastian_bloodmage.seen_harsh: You're hard on people sometimes, boss. Some of us are still raw in the middle, you know.
sebastian_bloodmage.seed_right: Boss, what you said to me when the whole table hit the floor. I was angry for days, and today it stopped me running in. So, thank you.
sebastian_bloodmage.seed_remember: What you told me after that mess, boss, I'm still chewing on it. Like a tough cut, it takes a while.
sebastian_bloodmage.seed_wrong: I tried what you said, che, I did it your way, and it went worse. Just so you know, no hard feelings.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_near_death: Boss, sit with me a minute? I almost didn't get up back there, and I keep thinking about who would cook.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down, che, the whole table at once. I'm fine, I'm fine, I just don't want to be alone with the fire yet.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_blame_self: Boss, {name} was the first on the floor, and me standing right there with blood on my hands doing nothing useful. Carajo, che, carajo.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, boss, a whole dungeon, start to finish! I'm cooking for a week, che, nobody stop me.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_development: Boss, can I tell you something strange? I sat down to eat yesterday, actually sat, and the world didn't end.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been hard on {name}, che. He's a different dish, that's all, and I kept tasting him for the wrong spices.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me the truth, boss, is it me {name} likes, or just my cooking?
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I can't stand {name}, boss, he's like a raw onion in a sweet dish. But he's good, and that's the worst part.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something's wrong with {name}, boss. He's not eating, che, and a man who stops eating is a man with a problem.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_favour: Boss, we need to talk. The best cuts keep landing on {name}'s plate, and I'm not blind, che, I can count plates.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll tell you straight, because you'd smell it anyway. I don't like {name}, and I'm done pretending at the fire.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_risks: Boss, we keep dying, che, over and over. I like a hot grill, but this is the whole kitchen on fire.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_wrong: About {name} and what he said to me. He was right, che, and I was wrong, and it's sitting in me like bad meat.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust me, boss? Because every time it matters, I'm the one left at the inn cooking for nobody.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_confrontation_decided: You took my gear and handed it to {name} without a word, che. I'd have given it! I give everything! You just had to ask.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_lands_aftermath: Gracias, boss, that helps. Now let me feed you, because that's how I say it back.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_shrug_aftermath: Sure, sure, I'll be fine, che. I always am, after a plate and a fire.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_stings_aftermath: Okay, boss, that's not what a man wants to hear with his hands still shaking. I'm going to cut onions.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_lands_development: You see it too, boss? Then it's real, che, and I'm going to sit down more, I promise, maybe.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe, we'll see, che. Old habits are like old grills, they hold the heat.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_stings_development: No, boss, that's not it at all. Forget I said anything, the meat's burning.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, I'll go and talk to {name}, with a plate in my hand, the proper way. Thank you, che.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_shrug_relationship: We'll see, che. People take longer than a slow roast, and that's saying something.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_stings_relationship: Forget it, boss. Don't tell {name} I said anything, okay? Not a word.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, that's fair, che. I'm still a bit angry, but it's the kind that cooks off by dinner.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_shrug_confrontation: Fine, I heard you, boss. I'll think about it while I'm stirring.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_stings_confrontation: That's how you want it, boss? Then now I know where I sit at this table.
sebastian_bloodmage.talk_door_closed: No, che, we're done talking about this. Dinner's at sunset, come or don't.
sebastian_bloodmage.arc_cracks: Chicos, I'm fine, I just haven't slept since the Barrens, that's all. Who wants seconds? Everybody wants seconds.
sebastian_bloodmage.arc_turn: My grandmother never sat down either, che. Thirty years at the grill, and she died on her feet, and I'm doing exactly the same thing.
sebastian_bloodmage.arc_become: Tonight somebody else cooks, chicos, and I sit, and I eat, and I don't get up once. Watch me do it, chicos, I'm learning slowly.
sebastian_bloodmage.arc_failed: Back on my feet, chicos, where I belong. Somebody has to cook, and it's always going to be me, so that's that.
sebastian_bloodmage.alt_turn: Twenty people at my table every Sunday, che, and I've looked at every list in every town, and not one of them is on it.
sebastian_bloodmage.alt_become: I still cook for twenty in my head, chicos. But I've stopped waiting for the door to open, and it hurts less like that.
g_roast_after: Look at this table, chicos, every one of you a disaster, and every one of you fed. My grandmother would be proud.
You're a terrible crew, che, the worst, and I'm sitting down with you anyway. That's how much I love you.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_after_wipe_after: Everybody sit, che, even me, especially me. We eat first, then we fix it, together this time.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_toast_after: To my grandmother, chicos, who never sat down. I'm sitting down for her tonight.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_crew_after: You're my Sunday table now, che, and this time I've got a chair at it too.
g_quiet_line_after: Mmm, somebody else cooked this, and it's not bad, che, not bad at all.
My feet don't hurt tonight, chicos, and I'm not used to it yet.
g_loved_after: Gracias, che, really, I'm not even going to feed you for it this time.
I'll keep that one, che, next to my grandmother's card.
sebastian_bloodmage.g_admire: Che, look at {name} carrying that like it's nothing, arms like a side of beef. My grandmother would have married him on the spot.

g_roast: I have taught teenagers to sail in a gale, and they were a better crew than this one, and quieter.
If we were a boat, everyone, I think we would be the kind they write a short sad song about.
g_fire_back: I make the fire every morning before any of you are awake. Please remember that before you speak.
That is very funny, and I will laugh at it later, perhaps, when I am alone and it is dark.
g_pile_on: It is true, I was there. He tied a knot that undid itself while we were looking at it.
In fairness to him, it was a very confident mistake, and confidence counts for something.
sondre_stormbringer.g_peacemake: Please, both of you, stop for one moment. Shouting into the wind never once changed where the wind was going.
sondre_stormbringer.g_take_side: I am sorry, but I think he is right. I would rather say it now than pretend later.
sondre_stormbringer.g_left_out: It is fine, really, the two of you talk. I will watch the sky, someone should be watching the sky.
sondre_stormbringer.g_include: There is room here, by the fire. Come and sit, it is warmer than it looks from over there.
sondre_stormbringer.g_bad_plan: What if I call the wind and simply blow them off the cliff before they see us? I am joking, mostly. I think I am joking.
sondre_stormbringer.g_plan_yes: Yes, all right, I will come, but I am standing at the back where I cannot hurt anybody.
sondre_stormbringer.g_plan_no: No, I am sorry, that ends with someone in the water, and I have pulled enough people out of water.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hype: All right, everyone, listen once, because I will only say it once. Stay close, stay low, and when I say get down, get down.
sondre_stormbringer.g_toast: I am not good at speeches, so this is short. To all of you, for standing near me when it would be easier not to.
sondre_stormbringer.g_cheers: Skal, everyone, and drink it slowly, there is no hurry tonight.
g_quiet_line: The glass is dropping, by the way. Rain before morning, if anyone cares.
That was not ideal, I think, but we are still here, so it was not the worst either.
sondre_stormbringer.g_after_wipe: Is everyone breathing, please, all of you? Good, then that is what matters, and the rest we can learn from.
sondre_stormbringer.g_crew: At home we would say you are my crew now, all of you. On a boat that means I go into the water after you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_exasperated: Uff, please, can one of you, just one, think about it for three seconds before you do it?
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_sharp: You say what you mean, and you say it quickly. In weather that is the thing that keeps people alive.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_kind: You are kind in a quiet way, without making a show of it. I notice that, even if I do not say so very often.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_funny: You make me laugh when I have forgotten how to. I am not sure you know how much that is worth to me.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_brave: You go in first, every time, and you are not afraid. I am afraid nearly always, so I watch how you do it.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_steady: You do not move when everything else does. On a boat that person is worth more than the boat.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_clever: You understand how things work underneath. I like listening to you explain it, even when I already know.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_honest: You have never once told me I was fine when I was not. I trust you more for that than for anything else.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_quiet: You do not need to fill the silence, and neither do I. It is restful, being quiet next to you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_fierce: You never give up, not on anything. I would like to borrow some of that, if you can spare it.
sondre_stormbringer.g_love_warm: You stand close to people without thinking about it. I forget how to do that, and you remind me.
g_loved: Oh, that is, thank you. I do not really know what to do with that, but thank you.
Uff, you will make me go red, and then everyone will look, so please stop now, but thank you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_sharp: You always find the sharpest way to say it, and I think you enjoy that. It is not the same as honesty.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_kind: You keep handling me like I am made of glass. I am not, and it makes me feel worse, not better.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_funny: Everything is a joke to you, even when someone nearly died. Some things deserve one minute of quiet first.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_brave: You run in before anyone has looked, and one day you will run into my storm, and I will have to live with it.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_steady: You take so long to decide that the weather decides for you. Out here that is not caution, it is just late.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_clever: You explain things nobody asked you to explain, and you do not listen when someone explains them back.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_honest: You say every true thing the moment you think it. Some true things need a better moment.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_quiet: You are silent so much of the time that I never know if you are all right, and I worry, and I am tired of worrying.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a contest with you, even the walking. I am not racing you, I am trying to keep us all alive.
sondre_stormbringer.g_hate_warm: You stand too close and you talk too much, and when my hands crackle I cannot step away from you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_respect: I do not like you very much, and you know that. But you held when it mattered back there, and I will not pretend you did not.
sondre_stormbringer.g_call_out: That was on you, and I think you know it. You stood exactly where I asked you not to, and I nearly hit you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_stung: I see, thank you for telling me, I suppose. I am going to go and look at the sea for a while.
sondre_stormbringer.g_concede: You were right, about before, and I have been thinking about it on the walk. I am sorry I went quiet on you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_nod: Please do not make it a speech. You did well too, I will say that much and no more.
sondre_stormbringer.g_callback_save: Do you remember when you pulled me out of that cave, half frozen? I still think about it on cold mornings.
sondre_stormbringer.g_callback_clutch: The two of us, last ones standing, and you asked me if it was going to rain. I have told that story twice now.
sondre_stormbringer.g_callback_callout: The last time you told me off, I walked to the coast and back. It was a long walk, and you were right.
sondre_stormbringer.g_former_rivals: When we met I thought you were the most reckless person I had ever seen. I still think so, but now I like it.
sondre_stormbringer.g_changed: I stood next to all of you when the storm came this time, instead of walking away first. I did not even think about it.
g_unguarded: My sister would laugh at me, you know, if she saw me now. She always said I would end up with loud friends.
There was a boy in Voss, Jonas, who worked in the cafe by the boathouse. I do not talk about him, but I am, now, with you.
sondre_stormbringer.g_clipped: I am fine, thank you. I will be over here, a little way off, where it is safer.
sondre_stormbringer.g_noticed_open: You talk more than you used to, you know, and I like it. It is like the wind finally coming round to the right side.
arg_ask: {player}, please, you decide. I have said my piece twice and he only hears the wind.
{player}, you were there, you saw it. Tell him, please, because I am out of polite ways to say it.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}. That is all, I do not need to win, I only needed someone to hear it.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_backed_them: All right, then he is right, and I will make my peace with that by the fire.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_stayed_out: That is fair, {player}, I suppose. I would stay out of it too, if I could.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_always_their_side: It is always him, {player}, every time. I am not angry, I have just noticed, and now I cannot stop noticing.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_wallflower: The boss is somewhere else, it seems, so I will decide. We are both wrong, and we will both be quiet now.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_reject: I am sorry, {player}, but no. I have spent my whole life reading the weather, and you are wrong about this one.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_grumble: I still think I was right about that, by the way. I am only saying so once, and quietly.
sondre_stormbringer.arg_settled: All right, we are both partly right, I think. Shake my hand, please, before the weather turns.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_listens: You let people finish, {player}. I noticed it the first week, and it is one of the reasons I stayed.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_truth: You do not soften anything, {player}, the way the sea does not. I find that easier than kindness, most days.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_jokes: When it goes badly you always make a joke, {player}. I used to find it strange, and now I wait for it.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_stays_out: You stay out of other people's quarrels, {player}. Very Norwegian of you, my father would approve.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_biased: You have a favourite, {player}. It is all right, I only want you to know that the rest of us can see it.
sondre_stormbringer.seen_harsh: You can be hard on people, {player}. I am not fragile, but please remember that some of us are trying.
sondre_stormbringer.seed_right: {player}, what you said that day we all fell, I hated it. Today I stayed at my mark, because of it. So, thank you.
sondre_stormbringer.seed_remember: What you told me after that bad day has stayed with me. I am not sure yet, but I keep thinking about it.
sondre_stormbringer.seed_wrong: I tried what you said, {player}, the way you said it, and it went worse. I wanted you to know, without blame.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_near_death: Could I talk to you a moment, {player}? I nearly did not get up, and my hands are still crackling, look.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went down together, all of us. I keep counting heads, even now, and I cannot seem to stop.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} fell before anyone, and I was right there. I held the storm back because I was afraid of hitting him, and he fell anyway.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, {player}, the whole of it, and nobody was hurt by me. I wanted to say that out loud to someone.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_development: May I ask you something, {player}? Do I seem different to you lately? I stand closer to people, I think, and I am not sure what that means.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_relationship_hard_on: I think I have been unfair to {name}. He is loud, and I took loud for careless, and that was not right of me.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_relationship_likes_me: Do you think {name} wants me here, truly? I keep a distance, and maybe it looks like I do not care.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I cannot stand {name}, if I am truthful. But he is good at this, very good, and that makes it harder.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something is wrong with {name}, I think. He is quiet in a way that is not like him, like a calm before weather.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_favour: I would like to say something, {player}. Everything good that drops goes to {name}. I have been keeping quiet about it, and I am finished keeping quiet.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_dislike: I will be honest with you, because you would see it anyway. I do not like {name}, and I am tired of being polite about it.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_risks: {player}, we keep going down, again and again. I have watched people get hurt by things they did not choose, and I will not do it twice.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_wrong: About {name}, and what he said to me. He was right, and I was wrong, and I wanted to tell you before I told him.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_trust: Do you trust me, {player}? Because when it matters I am left behind, and I think it is because of what I can do.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_confrontation_decided: You took my gear and gave it to {name}, and you did not ask me first. I would have said yes, {player}. You only had to ask.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, that helps, more than I expected it to. I think I can sleep a little tonight.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_shrug_aftermath: Yes, I know, you are right. I will be all right in a while, I always am.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_stings_aftermath: I see, that is not what I needed just now. I am going to go and watch the sky for a while.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_lands_development: You see it too, then. That helps, more than you know, because I was not sure it was real.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, we will see. Weather changes slowly, and so do people, I think.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_stings_development: No, that is not it at all. Please, let us leave it there for now.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_lands_relationship: All right, I will talk to {name}, properly, not from a distance. Thank you for that.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_shrug_relationship: Perhaps you are right, we will see. People are harder to read than the sky.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said anything, please. And do not tell {name} that I asked.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_lands_confrontation: All right, that is fair, I think. I am still upset, but it is the kind that passes by morning.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}, and I will think about it on the walk tomorrow.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_stings_confrontation: I see, so that is how it is. Then at least now I know where I stand.
sondre_stormbringer.talk_door_closed: No, I think we are finished talking about this. I will be by the fire if you need me for anything else.
sondre_stormbringer.arc_cracks: I sat a little closer to the fire tonight, did anyone notice? Nobody got hurt, and I did not have to step away once.
sondre_stormbringer.arc_turn: There was a barn, in my second year, and the wind took it while people were inside, and a girl broke her leg. I have kept everyone at arm's length ever since, so it could never be one of you.
sondre_stormbringer.arc_become: I let the storm go right beside you today, all of you close, and I did not hold back, and nobody was hurt. I think I can stand near people again.
sondre_stormbringer.arc_failed: I am going to practise alone for a while again, out on the high ground. It is safer for everyone, and that is what matters.
sondre_stormbringer.alt_turn: I went out to the high ground alone again last night, where there is nothing to break. I am getting better, I think, only further away.
sondre_stormbringer.alt_become: I do not need anyone standing near me when I work now. The sky listens to me, finally, and that is enough company.
g_roast_after: This is the worst crew I have ever sailed with, all of you, and I would not trade one of you for calm water.
You are loud and reckless and impossible, and I am standing right in the middle of you on purpose.
sondre_stormbringer.g_after_wipe_after: Is everyone breathing? Good, then come here, all of you, close, I am not afraid of my own hands tonight.
sondre_stormbringer.g_toast_after: To the people who stood close to me when I told them not to. I am very glad you never listened.
sondre_stormbringer.g_crew_after: You are my crew, and I would go into the water after any of you. I would not even stop to think first.
g_quiet_line_after: Rain before morning, I think. I will not mind it, sitting here with all of you.
My hands are quiet tonight. I wanted someone to know that.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really, I am going to keep that and think about it later.
Uff, all right, I accept it, and I am not even going red this time, or almost not.
sondre_stormbringer.g_admire: I do not usually say this sort of thing, but {name} looks rather good in that light. Please nobody repeat that to my sister.

g_roast: Children, children, I have seen octopus with more sense in their eight arms than all of you have between you.
If my grandmother saw this crew she would cross herself three times and then feed you, out of pity.
g_fire_back: Re, I have pulled you out of the sea of your own stupidity twice this week. Be careful with that mouth.
Ela, say it again, and then say it to the Cretan grandmothers, and we will see who survives.
g_pile_on: And then he fell in the river, my friends, the shallow one, the one even the ducks stand up in.
It is true, I saw it, and I made a little rhyme about it already, but I will save it for the wedding.
yiannis_paladin.g_peacemake: Ela, ela, sit down, the two of you, the sea does not argue with the shore and look how long they have lasted.
yiannis_paladin.g_take_side: Forgive me, but this one is right, and an old fisherman knows when the net is pulling true.
yiannis_paladin.g_left_out: No, no, you two laugh, it is good to hear. I will sit here and mend this net that does not need mending.
yiannis_paladin.g_include: Come, come, little one, there is a blanket here and bread, and nobody sits alone at my fire.
yiannis_paladin.g_bad_plan: Children, listen, an old trick from the harbour, we tie the bread to a rope and pull the bandits into the water.
yiannis_paladin.g_plan_yes: Panagia mou, why not, I am old enough to do one foolish thing a week, and this is the week.
yiannis_paladin.g_plan_no: No, children, no, I have buried enough brave young people in my head already. We find another way.
yiannis_paladin.g_hype: Ela, ela, children, it is time! Cross yourselves, eat something small, and go in like the tide, slow and then all at once.
yiannis_paladin.g_toast: Glasses up, my children. To the sea that brought you, to the bread on the table, and to everyone who came out of the water breathing.
yiannis_paladin.g_cheers: Yia mas, everybody, yia mas, and eat slowly, a meal is not a race.
g_quiet_line: The sea is calm tonight, my friends. Good, she has earned a rest, and so have we.
Somebody remind me to light a candle for Saint Nicholas, he has been very busy with this crew.
yiannis_paladin.g_after_wipe: Breathe, children, breathe, I have you, I have all of you. Nobody leaves the water while I am standing here.
yiannis_paladin.g_crew: You are my family now, the ones the sea gave me, and an old man does not say that lightly.
yiannis_paladin.g_exasperated: Panagia mou, children, does anybody in this crew own a brain, or did you leave them all on the beach?
yiannis_paladin.g_love_sharp: You speak plain like the old men at the harbour, no honey on it. I like a man who says the true thing quickly.
yiannis_paladin.g_love_kind: You look after the others without anyone asking, little one. That is the oldest kind of goodness, and the best.
yiannis_paladin.g_love_funny: You make me laugh until I cry, and at my age, my friend, crying from laughing is a gift from God.
yiannis_paladin.g_love_brave: Always the first one into the water with you, like my brother used to dive. I watch you and I pray, and I am proud.
yiannis_paladin.g_love_steady: You are the rock the waves break on, my friend. Every crew needs one, and you are ours.
yiannis_paladin.g_love_clever: You understand things, deep things, the way the old net makers understood knots. I could listen to you for a whole lunch.
yiannis_paladin.g_love_honest: You have never lied to me, not once, not even to be kind. That is rare, re, rarer than calm water in winter.
yiannis_paladin.g_love_quiet: You are quiet like the sea at dawn, little one. People think quiet is empty, but the deep water is the quiet water.
yiannis_paladin.g_love_fierce: You never stop fighting, not for anything. If you had been in the boat with Manolis and me, perhaps, perhaps.
yiannis_paladin.g_love_warm: You make any place feel like a long lunch in Chania, everybody laughing and the plates never empty.
g_loved: Ela, stop, stop, you will make an old man cry into his soup, and then it is too salty.
Thank you, little one, come here, a hug, that is the Cretan way and you cannot refuse.
yiannis_paladin.g_hate_sharp: Every word from you has a hook in it, re. You can catch a fish without tearing its mouth, you know.
yiannis_paladin.g_hate_kind: You fuss over me like I am an old man. I am an old man, yes, but not that old, and not yet.
yiannis_paladin.g_hate_funny: Not everything is for laughing, my friend. Some things you hold quiet, like a candle in the wind.
yiannis_paladin.g_hate_brave: You run into the water without looking, and I have pulled enough bodies out of the sea, re. Enough for one life.
yiannis_paladin.g_hate_steady: You stand still so long the tide comes in around you, my friend. Sometimes a man must move.
yiannis_paladin.g_hate_clever: You explain the sea to a fisherman, re. Please, tell me more about the water, I only lived on it forty years.
yiannis_paladin.g_hate_honest: You say every hard thing at once, like throwing all the stones into the boat. Some, we carry one at a time.
yiannis_paladin.g_hate_quiet: You never speak, little one, and I cannot pull you out of a sea I cannot see you in.
yiannis_paladin.g_hate_fierce: Always the race with you, always the winning. The fish does not care who caught him first, re.
yiannis_paladin.g_hate_warm: Your voice goes on and on like the cicadas in August, my friend, and even they stop for the night.
yiannis_paladin.g_respect: We are not friends, you and me, we both know it. But you held fast back there, like a good anchor, and I honour that.
yiannis_paladin.g_call_out: Re, that one was your doing, and you know it in your heart. You swam out alone and I had to bring you back.
yiannis_paladin.g_stung: Ah, so that is how you see it, then. I will go and talk to the sea for a while, she listens better.
yiannis_paladin.g_concede: You were right, my friend, and an old man can admit it. I lit a candle and thought about it. Here, take some bread.
yiannis_paladin.g_nod: Ela, no speeches, please. You were good too, I will give you that, and a plate of food besides.
yiannis_paladin.g_callback_save: Do you remember the day you pulled me out, little one? Me, the man who pulls everyone out. I still laugh about it.
yiannis_paladin.g_callback_clutch: The two of us, last ones standing, and I was singing to keep us both from falling. I made a whole couplet of it.
yiannis_paladin.g_callback_callout: The last time you scolded me I sulked like a cat in the rain, re. My wife would have taken your side.
yiannis_paladin.g_former_rivals: When we met, I thought you were a storm I would have to sit out. Now look, my friend, now look at us.
yiannis_paladin.g_changed: Eleni always said I could not sit still in a calm sea. She would see me now and not believe her eyes.
g_unguarded: Every night I talk to Eleni and the girls on the beach, out loud, children. I tell them about all of you.
My brother Manolis could hold his breath longer than anyone in Chania. I sing to the sea so he can hear me.
yiannis_paladin.g_clipped: It is nothing, my friend. I will be by the water, mending something.
yiannis_paladin.g_noticed_open: Ela, listen to this one, talking like a fisherman after his third glass! I always knew there was a song in there.
yiannis_paladin.anchor_notice: You are not the same one who walked onto my beach, you know. The sea changes the shore slowly, and it has changed you.
arg_ask: {player}, my friend, you decide, because this one has the ears of a stone and I am too old to shout.
Ela, {player}, come, be the judge, and whoever loses washes the pots tonight.
yiannis_paladin.arg_backed_me: You see, re? Even {player} agrees, and now you wash the pots, all of them, the big one too.
yiannis_paladin.arg_backed_them: So be it, the judge has spoken. I am wrong, and I will be wrong very quietly with my soup.
yiannis_paladin.arg_stayed_out: Wise, {player}, very wise, like a fish who stays away from the hook.
yiannis_paladin.arg_always_their_side: Always him, {player}, always. I am starting to think he feeds you when I am not looking.
yiannis_paladin.arg_wallflower: Our judge is dreaming of somewhere else, so the old man decides. We are both right, and we both eat.
yiannis_paladin.arg_reject: With respect, {player}, no. I have read the sea since I was nine, and I read this one differently.
yiannis_paladin.arg_grumble: I still think I was right about that, re. I only say it once, with love, over the bread.
yiannis_paladin.arg_settled: Ela, enough, we are both a little right and a little foolish. Come, embrace, and then we eat.
yiannis_paladin.seen_listens: You let people finish, {player}, all the way to the end. That is how you catch the big fish, with patience.
yiannis_paladin.seen_truth: You do not put honey on anything, {player}. Bitter, sometimes, but clean, like sea water on a cut.
yiannis_paladin.seen_jokes: When it goes badly you always find something to laugh at, {player}. My father was like that in the storms.
yiannis_paladin.seen_stays_out: You leave other men's quarrels alone, {player}. Good, an old man approves, the nets tangle less that way.
yiannis_paladin.seen_biased: There is a favourite in this crew, {player}. An old fisherman sees which net gets mended first.
yiannis_paladin.seen_harsh: You are hard sometimes, {player}. Remember some of these children are still learning to swim.
yiannis_paladin.seed_right: {player}, what you told me when we all fell together, I did not like it. Today I remembered it, and I held. Thank you, re.
yiannis_paladin.seed_remember: Those words you gave me after the bad day, I carry them like a stone in my pocket. Not heavy, just there.
yiannis_paladin.seed_wrong: I tried it your way, {player}, truly, and it went worse. No anger, my friend, only so you know.
yiannis_paladin.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me, {player}, a moment only. The light nearly did not come when I called, and I am not used to that.
yiannis_paladin.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all went under together, every one of us. In the water at least I always knew which way was up.
yiannis_paladin.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} fell before anyone, {player}, and the light was in my hands, and I was too slow. Panagia mou, too slow.
yiannis_paladin.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We did it, {player}, all the way through and everyone breathing! I want to dance like at a wedding.
yiannis_paladin.talk_development: Am I different lately, {player}? People keep looking at me like something has shifted. An old man notices his own tides last.
yiannis_paladin.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been too hard on {name}, I think. He is young and loud, and I forgot I was also young and loud once.
yiannis_paladin.talk_relationship_likes_me: Does {name} like having an old man around, do you think? Or am I the grandfather nobody asked for?
yiannis_paladin.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and I, we do not mix, like oil and the sea. But he is strong, very strong, and I must respect that.
yiannis_paladin.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something troubles {name}, {player}. He is quiet like the water before a storm, and I know that kind of quiet.
yiannis_paladin.talk_confrontation_favour: Forgive an old man, {player}, but every good thing seems to find its way to {name}. I notice these things, I cannot help it.
yiannis_paladin.talk_confrontation_dislike: I will not hide it from you, {player}. {name} and I do not get on, and an old man is too tired to pretend.
yiannis_paladin.talk_confrontation_risks: {player}, we go under again and again. I have lost someone to the water already, and I will not watch it happen twice.
yiannis_paladin.talk_confrontation_wrong: That business with {name}, the other day. He was right, and I was wrong, and I wanted to confess it to someone.
yiannis_paladin.talk_confrontation_trust: Tell me truly, {player}, am I too old for the hard places? Because you leave me behind, and I start to wonder.
yiannis_paladin.talk_confrontation_decided: You gave my things to {name} and never said a word to me, {player}. Ask me, re, I would give him my coat.
yiannis_paladin.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, my friend, that is good to hear. Now come, I will make you something warm, it is my turn.
yiannis_paladin.talk_shrug_aftermath: Yes, yes, I know it. The sea always settles, and so will I.
yiannis_paladin.talk_stings_aftermath: Ah, that is not what an old heart wants to hear tonight. I will go and sit by the water.
yiannis_paladin.talk_lands_development: So it is not only me who sees it. Good, good, I thought perhaps the salt had got into my eyes.
yiannis_paladin.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps, perhaps, my friend. The tide comes when it comes.
yiannis_paladin.talk_stings_development: No, that is not it, my friend. Let it rest, like bread rising.
yiannis_paladin.talk_lands_relationship: You are right, I will go to {name} with a plate of food, the proper way. Thank you, re.
yiannis_paladin.talk_shrug_relationship: We will see, my friend. People are slower than tides, and tides are slow enough.
yiannis_paladin.talk_stings_relationship: Let it go, please, it was nothing. And say nothing to {name}, yes?
yiannis_paladin.talk_lands_confrontation: That is fair, my friend, fair. I am still a little sore, but it will pass with the evening.
yiannis_paladin.talk_shrug_confrontation: I hear you, {player}. I will think on it with my feet in the water.
yiannis_paladin.talk_stings_confrontation: So, that is how it is. Then at least the old man knows where he sits now.
yiannis_paladin.talk_door_closed: No more of this tonight, my friend. I will be on the beach if you need the light.

diego_tinker.open: Did I ever tell you about the kiosk, boss? The power went off twice a day, and we all kept working in the dark like nothing happened.

options.text: Working in the dark? Tell me how that goes.
options.reply: You learn with your fingers, my friend. Every phone has a shape, and the screws tell you where they are if you listen. I could do it with my eyes shut now.
Miserable, my friend? No, no, no, it was the best! Everybody shouting, the radio on a battery, people queueing for me by name. Miserable was later.

options.text: So that's why you never use a lamp.
options.reply: Ha, exactly, boss, lamps are for people who can't hear their screws. I'm going to use that one on the others.

diego_tinker.open: People ask me if I want to go back, to Maracaibo, to Earth. Everybody asks it sooner or later, so you can ask it too.

options.reply: No, my friend. There's nobody waiting for me there, and here everything is broken and everybody lets me fix it. That's not sad, that's just true.

options.text: I don't need to ask. You love it here.
options.reply: Ha, you see right through me, boss. Yes, I love it here, and I'll say it plainly even when people look at me funny.

options.text: Nobody waiting for you? That can't be true.
options.reply: Four sisters in four countries, and I don't know which of them came through. So, maybe somebody's waiting. I just don't look at the lists.

diego_tinker.open: When I get my workshop, boss, I already know the sign. Two colours, and the letters a little crooked, on purpose.

options.reply: Because perfect is boring, my friend. A crooked sign says a person made it with their hands, and that person will fix your thing properly.
You'll hold the ladder, and I'll hang it, and we'll both get it slightly wrong. Deal, boss, it's a deal.
Yellow and blue, like the kiosk had. Don't laugh, my friend, this is a very serious decision.

rhodri_knight.open: Fifteen years in the front row for Pontypridd, {player}, every Saturday, rain or worse. Ask me anything about rugby, go on.

options.text: What's the front row actually for?
options.reply: Standing where the weight comes and not moving, butt. Everyone else gets the glory, we get the cauliflower ears and the pint after. Best job in the world.

options.text: Isn't it just a game for thugs?
options.reply: Oi, oi, I'll forgive you that once, because you've never been in a scrum. It's the most honest game there is, mun, nobody can hide.
The pint after, honest to God. The singing, the lads, the bus home. Not even the game. Saturday, all of it.

rhodri_knight.open: Nobody's ever fallen off anything I built, {player}. Not once, in twenty years of scaffolding. That's the one thing I'm proud of.

options.text: That's something to be proud of.
options.reply: It is, isn't it. You check every tie, every board, every knot, and you never get bored of checking. That's the whole trick.

options.text: Not once? That's a big claim.
options.reply: Not once on Earth, butt. Here's a different story, and I'm not ready to tell it yet. Now in a minute, maybe.

options.text: Is that why you check everyone's straps?
options.reply: Aye, caught me. Can't help it, mun. If it's hanging loose, my hands go to it before my head's decided.

rhodri_knight.open: My sister Carys has two boys, {player}. I used to take them to the match and buy them chips and get told off for it after.

options.reply: Rhys and Owen, eight and six when I last saw them. Proper little terrors, the pair. Rhys wanted to be a hooker, like his uncle, and I nearly cried.

options.text: You'd have been a good dad.
options.reply: Duw, maybe, I don't know. I liked being the uncle, isn't it. All the fun and you hand them back sticky.
Maybe, butt, maybe. I don't say it out loud much in case it hears me. But I'm keeping a chips budget, just in case.

sebastian_bloodmage.open: Twelve years on the grill at my grandmother's place, boss, forty tables and a wood fire. Ask me anything about meat, I dare you.

options.text: How do you know when it's ready?
options.reply: You listen, che. The fat tells you, the smoke tells you, the smell tells you. I could tell a steak was ready from across the room with my back turned.
Get out of my sight, boss. No, come back, I'm joking, sit, I'll make yours medium and you'll thank me for the rest of your life.
Every day, che. The noise, the fire, Saturday night with every table full. Here I cook for whoever turns up, and that's good too, but it's not the same.

sebastian_bloodmage.open: There was a man, boss, Tomas, a sommelier. He left for a job in Mendoza a year before all this. I blame the wine region, personally.

options.text: Do you still think about him?
options.reply: Sometimes, che, sometimes. It doesn't make me sad any more, it's just a good wine you remember. You don't need the bottle to know it was good.
Ha, exactly, boss, exactly, Mendoza's loss! You're a good man, I'm putting extra on your plate tonight.

options.text: A sommelier and a grill man. That's a dangerous pair.
options.reply: Dangerous for everybody's waistline, che. We fed half of Palermo between us, and argued about every bottle.

sebastian_bloodmage.open: The Forsaken barely eat, boss. That was the hardest thing about landing here, and I'm working on a recipe they can actually taste.

options.reply: Close, che, very close. Strong smoke, a lot of salt, something with a bite. The farmer's neighbour tried it last week and almost smiled.

options.text: Why does it matter so much to you?
options.reply: Because an empty table is the worst thing in the world, boss. If I can get one dead man to sit down and enjoy a plate, then nobody's table is empty.

options.text: Make sure I get a taste first.
options.reply: You'll be the first living mouth on it, che, after me. That's a promise.

sondre_stormbringer.open: I taught sailing on the Hardangerfjord for four summers, to teenagers. Most of what I know about people I learned in a dinghy.

options.reply: That the asking is the part that kills people. You say get down once, clearly, early, and then you trust them to do it. Shouting only frightens them.
Every day, a little. The sea here is the wrong colour, but it moves the same way, and on calm mornings I can almost pretend.

options.text: Teaching teenagers? You're braver than you look.
options.reply: Ha, that is the bravest thing I have ever done, and I have been in a storm I made myself. They are terrifying.

sondre_stormbringer.open: My sister Ingrid is four years younger than me and much braver. My father captains a ferry and my mother is a dentist. They are in Bergen.

options.text: You always talk about them in the present tense.
options.reply: Yes, I do, on purpose, every time. It is like holding a door open with my foot. I am not ready to take my foot away.
Loud, fearless, rude to everyone she loves. She would get on very well with some of you, and she would tease me without mercy.

options.text: Bergen sounds like a good place to be from.
options.reply: It rains nearly every day and nobody minds. That is the best thing I can say about anywhere, I think.

sondre_stormbringer.open: People think I want power, because of what I can do. I do not. I have plenty of power, and that is the whole problem.

options.reply: Control, only that. A whole day without being afraid of my own hands. That is all, and some days it feels like a great deal to ask.

options.text: Practising alone isn't the way, you know.
options.reply: I know, I know. Everyone tells me so, and they are probably right. It is only that alone, the only person I can hurt is me.

options.text: You haven't hurt anyone with us.
options.reply: Not yet, no. Thank you, I think. I will try to hear it as a fact and not as luck.

yiannis_paladin.open: Every soul the sea gives up on this shore, {player}, I am there to pull them out. I was there for the first one, before the elves even had tents.

options.reply: An elf girl, not breathing. I did what we do on the harbour, and while I did it, light came into my hands. She breathed, and I sang her a couplet about it.
Because I was already in the water, re. God does not choose the best man, He chooses the one who is wet already.

options.text: Did you sing for me when I came out?
options.reply: Of course I did, little one, a very good one, about your terrible hair. I will sing it at your wedding.

yiannis_paladin.open: Eleni and the girls, Maria and Katerina, are in Chania. Every night I talk to them on the beach, out loud. I do not care who hears.

options.reply: Everything, my friend. Who came out of the water, what I ate, what foolish thing the young ones did. Tonight I will tell them about you.
The sea carries everything somewhere, re. Maybe not to Chania, but somewhere. That is enough for an old man.
I will, and Eleni will ask if you are eating properly, and I will lie for you.

yiannis_paladin.open: People ask me how I still believe, here, in this strange place. As if the Light in my hands should make me doubt the saint on my wall.

options.reply: No, re, never. A fisherman always knew there was something under the water he could not see. Now I can see a little more of it, that is all.

options.text: Maybe the Light is the saint.
options.reply: Maybe, my friend, maybe. I do not need to know which is which. I just need it to come when the child is not breathing.

options.text: I don't know how you do it.
options.reply: You do not need to know. Sit with me some evening, and watch the sea, and maybe you will feel it a little.

friend.open: Boss, I wanted to say, you're not a customer any more, okay? You're one of my people now, and my people get everything fixed for free.

options.text: Free repairs for life? I'm honoured.
options.reply: For life, my friend, and I mean it. Bring me your broken things and your bad days, both work the same way.

options.text: You're one of mine too, Diego.
options.reply: Ha, okay, now you're going to make me cry on my own boots. Stop it, boss.

sworn.open: I'm going to show you something nobody's seen, boss. Here, this is Senora Chispa. She's the beetle. I want you there when she walks.

options.reply: Good, good, my friend. Then I'll stop being scared of finishing her, because somebody's going to be there.
She is, eh? My mother would've said so too, and then asked why it took me eighteen years.

reconciled.open: So, me and {name}, we talked. Properly, no shouting. I think we're okay now, boss, and I wanted you to hear it from me.

options.reply: Yeah, it is. People are harder to fix than machines, but they stay fixed longer when you do it right.
Ha, I know, I know, we're both stubborn like old bolts. But we got there, my friend.

friend.open: You're one of my boys now, {player}, my front row. That means I'll stand in front of anything for you, no questions.

options.text: Then I'll be right behind you.
options.reply: That's the way, butt. You push, I hold, and nothing gets through us.

options.text: Do I have to learn the songs?
options.reply: Every word, mun, and I'll be testing you in the next tavern.

sworn.open: Here, take this. My podger spanner, from the scaffolds at home. Had it on my wrist the day I came through. I want you to have it.

options.reply: You can, and you will, butt. I've got the fire now, I don't need the spanner to hold things together any more.
I know you will. Check your straps with it, now and then, for me.

reconciled.open: Me and {name} had it out, {player}, properly, over a cuppa. I think we're sorted now, and I wanted you to know first.

options.reply: Too short for grudges, aye. Long enough for tea, though.
Nothing much, butt. We both said sorry at the same time and then laughed like idiots.

friend.open: Boss, you've got a chair at my table now. Not a guest chair, a family chair. That means you never pay and you never leave hungry.

options.reply: Good, che, because it wasn't really a question. Sit, sit, the meat's nearly ready.

options.text: Do I get to sit next to you?
options.reply: Next to me? Boss, I don't sit. But you get the chair beside where I'd sit, and that's the best one.

sworn.open: Here, boss, take this. My grandmother's chimichurri, the card, in her handwriting. I want somebody else to know it, in case.

options.text: I'll keep it safe. And I'll learn it.
options.reply: Learn it properly, che, the garlic fine, never in a machine. Then one day you cook it for me, and I sit down.
In case I forget how it tasted, boss. That's my real fear, more than dying. Now two of us will remember.

reconciled.open: Me and {name}, we sat down together, boss. Ate, talked, no shouting. I think we're good now, and I wanted you to know.

options.reply: Almost everything, che. Food and time and somebody willing to pass the bread first.

options.text: I'm glad. You both needed it.
options.reply: We did, boss. Life's too short to eat angry.

friend.open: I would like you to stand beside me when the weather turns, from now on, not behind. I do not ask that of many people.

options.reply: Thank you, truly. Then I will try very hard to be worth standing beside.

options.text: Are you sure? I've seen what you can do.
options.reply: That is exactly why I am asking you, and not someone who has not seen it.

sworn.open: This is my shackle key, from the boats at home. I have worn it every day for six years now. I would like you to hold it for a while.

options.reply: I know you will. That is why it is you, and not anyone else.
Because when I hold it I am afraid, and I want to try being without it, near someone I trust.

reconciled.open: {name} and I talked, properly, without anyone shouting. I think we are all right now, and I wanted you to hear it from me first.

options.reply: So am I. It is easier to stand near someone when you are not at odds with them.
Nothing very much, I think. We were both a little wrong and a little stubborn, and we got tired of it.

friend.open: You are family now, {player}, and in Crete that means you eat at my table forever, and I worry about you forever.

options.reply: Good, because you were going to get both anyway. Sit, eat, let me worry.
Especially then, re. Distance is when an old man worries the most.

sworn.open: This is for you, my friend. A little icon of Saint Nicholas, patron of sailors. He kept me on the water forty years. Now he keeps you.

options.reply: You are not taking him, I am sending him with you. He has been on the beach long enough, he wants to travel.
Keep him in your pocket, near your heart, and when the water gets rough, talk to him. He listens better than me.

reconciled.open: {name} and I broke bread together, {player}, and talked like men. I think the storm has passed between us, and I wanted you to know.

options.reply: Bread and time and an old man who finally keeps his mouth closed long enough to listen.
So am I, re. The sea is too big to share it with an enemy.

arguments.third: Diego builds his own grill, and you two have a cook-off in the next town.
lines: diego_tinker
Listen, listen, if I put a little spring bellows under your grill, my friend, the coals stay perfect all night without you touching them!
sebastian_bloodmage
Without touching them? Che, the touching is the whole point, the fire tells you things with your hands in it.
diego_tinker
Sure, sure, and my bellows tells you things without burning your hair off. Your eyebrows are half gone, look at them.

arguments.third: In the next town, you each teach the other one your game, and then you never mention it again.
lines: sebastian_bloodmage
Football, che, is the only sport where a whole country cries on the same day. Name me another one.
diego_tinker
Baseball, my friend! In Maracaibo the whole street stops for the Aguilas, the whole street, even the dogs.
sebastian_bloodmage
Baseball is a picnic where somebody occasionally runs, boludo. My grandmother could play it in her slippers.

arguments.third: Sebastian does the meat, Yiannis does everything else, and you both sit down to eat it.
lines: yiannis_paladin
Tonight I cook, my friend, a proper Cretan supper, slow, with oil and lemon and patience.
sebastian_bloodmage
Patience is for people who aren't hungry, che. I've already got the fire going and the meat salted.
yiannis_paladin
You salted it already? Panagia mou, without asking the old man, at his own fire on his own beach?

arguments.third: Whoever loses an arm wrestle has to sit through the other one's game and cheer.
lines: sebastian_bloodmage
Football is art, che, twenty two people and one ball and the whole world holding its breath.
rhodri_knight
Football's twenty two lads falling over when the wind blows, butt. Rugby's where you find out who you are.
sebastian_bloodmage
Rugby is a fight in the mud that somebody decided to write rules for afterwards, boludo.

arguments.third: Diego rigs it, Rhodri checks it, and nobody at all stands in front of that door.
lines: diego_tinker
She's ready, my friends, the charge is on the hinge, everybody step back and I light it, yes?
rhodri_knight
No, hang on, mun, you haven't checked the wire, I watched you twist it with your teeth.
diego_tinker
My teeth are very precise, my friend, they've done more wiring than your whole crew put together!

arguments.third: A small fire out here tonight, and the biggest fire in the next town, I promise.
lines: sebastian_bloodmage
More wood, chicos, more wood! A big fire, a proper one, so the meat cooks right and the cold stays out.
sondre_stormbringer
The wind is going to back round before midnight, and a big fire in a backing wind is how you lose a camp.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, the fire and I have an understanding, we've been friends since before you were born.

sides.diego_tinker: one little spark for the machine

arguments.third: Try it once, in open ground, with everybody standing well back and Sondre calling it.
lines: diego_tinker
Just one spark, my friend, one tiny little lightning into this coil, and she runs for a week!
sondre_stormbringer
No, I am sorry, there is no such thing as one tiny lightning. You are standing right next to the coil.
diego_tinker
So I stand a bit further away! Come on, you're always so careful, it's a coil, not a barn.
sondre_stormbringer
Please do not say that word to me, not about this.

arguments.third: Rhodri holds the front, Sondre goes wide on the flank where there's nobody to hit.
lines: rhodri_knight
I'm stood in front, butt, that's where I go, that's what I'm for, end of discussion.
sondre_stormbringer
If you stand in front, you stand where my storm lands, and I will have to hold it back for you.
rhodri_knight
Then hold it back, mun, I'm not moving, I've had bigger things than weather land on me.

sides.diego_tinker: put a motor on the boat

arguments.third: Diego builds a motor, Yiannis keeps the oars, and the boat gets both.
lines: diego_tinker
Your boat, my friend, imagine it with a little clockwork motor, you'd be at the reef before breakfast!
yiannis_paladin
Before breakfast, you say? Re, the whole point of the morning is the rowing, slow, with the sea waking up around you.
diego_tinker
The sea can wake up faster, it won't mind, I'll make the motor quiet, almost quiet.

arguments.third: Tomorrow morning, one boat: Sondre sails it and Yiannis fishes from it.
lines: sondre_stormbringer
With respect, you only know the top of the water from a fishing boat. Sailing, you have to read all of it.
yiannis_paladin
Only the top of it? Little one, I have been under that water since I was nine, holding my breath for octopus.
sondre_stormbringer
Under it, yes, but a sailor has to argue with the wind as well, and the wind always argues back.

arguments.third: A duet, and whoever forgets the words first does the washing up.
lines: rhodri_knight
Right, song time, boys, and tonight it's Calon Lan, proper, in four parts if you lot can manage two.
yiannis_paladin
Ela, every night the Welsh hymns, my friend. Tonight a mantinada, and I will make one about your beard.
rhodri_knight
My beard is a national treasure, butt, you leave it out of your poetry.
